interpretation: Review completion and integration completion are different. 1250/1285 is a review-binding count only, never whole-goal completion.

A differing foreign set is an integration/reconciliation item, not automatic authority to apply every proposed edge. Effective inherited prerequisites, scope/source support, granularity, DAG and route gates still need checking.
An equal foreign set does not prove complete Goal/P/Kind/source/target/learner acceptance. Most equal reviewed sets require no cross-subject edge.
This audit makes no new scientific verdict and does not amend or downgrade original review decisions.
